correctness.rationale: For squarefree n=abc, the primary divisor formula gives H(n)=F(a)F(b)F(c)/(abc). Every prime requires an incoming edge; integer descent forbids loops and 2-cycles, so a 3-cycle is necessary and sufficient. The witness B=411612748708891 reduces the global minimum to primes p with p³≤B, divisors u|F(p) with pu(p+1)≤B, and divisors v|F(u) with p<v≤B/(pu) and p|F(v). The packaged exact sieve-and-factor certificate counts 7339 p, 1948 first edges, and exactly one closing triple. Both sieves cover every possible trial factor and primality of 349,121453,9710803 is checked; H(B)=410433300314317 exactly. No heuristic step enters the proof.
